required_patterns.router-inclusion: The FastAPI app is built in src/main.py:get_app() and includes routers via app.include_router(router).

architectural_constraints.no-business-logic-in-router: Routers should mostly orchestrate: parse request, call service, return schema; avoid embedding complex auth/session rules directly in endpoint handlers.

required_patterns.jwt-access: Access tokens are JWTs containing sub (user_id) and sid (session_id).
required_patterns.refresh-rotation: Refresh tokens are rotated; only hashed refresh tokens are stored.

architectural_constraints.session-check: All protected endpoints must validate session existence via Redis (session:{user_id}:{session_id}) before trusting the JWT.
architectural_constraints.token-version: Protected access must reject tokens when redis_session.token_version != user.token_version.

required_patterns.async-sqlalchemy: Database access is SQLAlchemy async; sessions are AsyncSession.
required_patterns.repository-layer: DB queries are encapsulated in repositories (e.g., UserRepository, SessionRepository).

architectural_constraints.async-only: Avoid blocking DB calls or sync SQLAlchemy engine usage in request paths.

required_patterns.redis-session-store: Redis stores session data keyed by session:{user_id}:{session_id} with TTL.
required_patterns.db-source-of-truth: Postgres stores device sessions for enumeration and management UI; Redis is a fast validation cache.

architectural_constraints.revoke-consistency: Revoking a session should delete Redis key and delete the DB session row.

required_patterns.pydantic-settings: Settings are loaded from src/conf/.env via pydantic-settings BaseSettings.
required_patterns.derived-properties: Derived properties include postgres_dsn and redis_url.

architectural_constraints.single-settings-class: New settings should be added to src/settings.py rather than scattered env parsing.

required_patterns.structlog: Logging is configured with structlog and stdlib integration.
required_patterns.correlation-id: Requests bind correlation_id into structlog contextvars.

architectural_constraints.structured-logs: Prefer logger.info('message', key=value) rather than string formatting so logs remain queryable.

required_patterns.custom-openapi-generator: OpenAPI schema generation is centralized in src/utils/openapi.py and registered in configure_production_app().

architectural_constraints.docs-endpoints: Swagger/ReDoc routes are mounted in src/main.py under /swagger and /redoc (docs_url/redoc_url are disabled in FastAPI constructor).

required_patterns.alembic-autogenerate: Alembic uses Model.metadata from src/models/utils.py as target_metadata.
required_patterns.pydantic-jsonb-render: Alembic render_item maps PydanticJSON to postgresql.JSONB(astext_type=sa.Text()).

architectural_constraints.metadata-conventions: Constraint/index naming conventions are defined in src/models/utils.py:my_metadata and should remain stable to avoid migration churn.
